documents.title: Update On Proposed Investment In M/S. Siravit Ceramics Private Limited
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Somany Ceramics reported moderate sales volume growth of 3% in Q1 FY27, impacted by production shutdowns in Morbi, while value grew by 24% and EBITDA margins expanded to 11.6% due to higher capacity utilization and improved JV performances. Management highlighted volatility in natural gas prices, noting that price increases have been successfully passed on, and expressed a strong outlook for future quarters. The company announced plans for a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South and various debottlenecking initiatives to expand capacity. Furthermore, management expects to sustain or improve its current EBITDA margins and aims for mid-single-digit volume growth for the year. Somany Ceramics Limited reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore and EBITDA margin improving to 11.6%.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in the quarter would be sustained and is trying to better them going forward.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects mid-single-digit volume growth for the year.
The company's guidance is to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more.
guidance.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

guidance.claim: Management stated that volume growth for the tile business will be in very healthy single digits.
guidance.quote: volume will be in a single -- very decent single digits for the tile business.

guidance.claim: Sanitaryware and adhesive business growth is expected to be in very healthy double digits.
guidance.quote: For the sanitaryware and adhesive business would be in very healthy double digits.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in May and June was pretty decent, and July has also been acceptable despite rains in many parts of the country.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about industry growth prospects supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and February.
demand_outlook.quote: the domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and Feb on account of increased domestic demand reducing the pressure on -- from reducing the pressure from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: March was an aberration month because of geopolitical circumstances.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

demand_outlook.claim: Tile is a product that will not be fungible with another flooring or wall material, leading to pent-up demand.
demand_outlook.quote: the tile is a product which will not go -- will not be fungible with another flooring or wall material. So there will be a pent-up demand even if it's a delayed demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which will be ready in the next 12 to 15 months and provide a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months. This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is taking steps to augment further capacity by 4 million to 5 million in existing lines in Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South, ready from mid-quarter 3 and complete in quarter 4.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South. All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

capex_expansion.claim: The major capex plan for next year is the 9-plus million square meter plant in the South with an approximate outlay of INR220 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, the major capex plan is the 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which is approximately INR220 crores outlay, which is for next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital outlay from now to the end of FY27 is approximately INR275 crores, including the INR220 crores plant and balancing equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has announced a new manufacturing facility to cater to the growing Southern market with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested INR30 crores to improve the capacity utilization level in Somany Max by adding a press.
capex_expansion.quote: We put in an investment of INR30 crores to make the utilization level better in Somany Max by putting the press.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex will be contained in INR70 crores to INR80 crores for routine capex and balancing equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment to make our assets more value-added or more -- towards more capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter increased by 3.6% to 11.6% due to operational efficiencies from capacity utilization and JV performances.
margins_costs.quote: As a result of capacity utilization, our EBITDA margins have gone up on operational efficiencies, both on capacity utilization in our plants and also on the JV performances. So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gas prices have been volatile with small monthly increases, but the company has been able to pass on price increases between 16% and 18%.
margins_costs.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price. Fortunately, we've been able to pass on all the gas price increase until now. So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%.

margins_costs.claim: The blended natural gas price is about INR68 in the North and in the mid-70s in the South and Morbi.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68. And South, we're still buying partly in spot. So South is -- South and Morbi are pretty much at the same level, which is close to mid-70s. And in the North, it is slightly lower, which is around the INR68, INR69 level. This is for natural gas.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6% driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improved significantly by 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% for the entire year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA improved quite significantly, 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% in the entire year.

margins_costs.claim: Gas price increased very significantly after the war broke out.
margins_costs.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that. I'm sure there'll be a lot of question-answers around that.

margins_costs.claim: In retail, the company has been able to pass on 100% of the cost.
margins_costs.quote: in the retail, we've been able to pass on 100% of the cost.

orders_capacity.claim: Morbi operations have resumed 100% production using expensive gas supplied by GEL.
orders_capacity.quote: Morbi operations have completely started. They have resumed 100% production on very expensive gas, which is on -- which is being supplied by GEL, formerly known as GSPCL.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization was largely flat, moving from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%. So that is largely flat.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently running plants at 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So we're running plant at 100% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The net dealer addition was 200 dealers across India, taking total showrooms to about 3,100.
orders_capacity.quote: We've added net new additions of 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days have decreased from 17 to 12 days, and receivables and inventory have been reduced.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days. Overall, we are extremely bullish of the future outlook.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately 65% to 70% of the INR275 crores capex outlay will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: So all put together, we are at about INR275 crores, and we will be funding about 65%, 70% of this through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital was marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital, we've done fairly well. It's marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cannot do a share buyback for the next 6 to 8 months due to an embargo from SEBI while consolidating wholly owned subsidiaries.
capital_allocation.quote: Unfortunately, we are consolidating some of our JV -- sorry, our wholly owned subs, and therefore, there is an embargo on -- from SEBI. We can't do a share buyback for the next 6, 8 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: The only negative in the quarter from a Morbi perspective is that exports are down by 50% to 60% from the peak due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry faced a March outage where nothing really sailed or went out for exports.
risks_headwinds.quote: it got stopped at 17 and something because -- INR17,000-and-something crores because of the March outage, where nothing really went or sailed in March.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a major labor shortage in Morbi.
risks_headwinds.quote: There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi.

management_commitments.claim: The new 9 million square meter plant in the South will be up and ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: Debottlenecking and balancing equipment additions will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and completely in place in quarter 4.
management_commitments.quote: All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

management_commitments.claim: The greenfield plant in the South will be operational by the end of quarter 3 or beginning of quarter 4 of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: The company's focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will continue to leverage strong brand equity and an extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management has taken an aggressive double-digit target for sanitaryware.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

management_commitments.claim: The company's guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from the base by at least 1.5% or more.
management_commitments.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
